question: Could you provide the annual percentage shares, rounded to two decimal places, of the top 5 minor crime categories from 2008 in London's total crimes, with each year displayed in one row?
sql:
WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
total_crimes AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    t.year,
    t.minor_category,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(t.value), tc.total) * 100, 2) as percentage_share
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` t
  JOIN total_crimes tc ON t.year = tc.year
  WHERE t.minor_category IN (SELECT minor_category FROM top5_2008)
  GROUP BY t.year, t.minor_category, tc.total
)
SELECT 
  year,
  STRING_AGG(CONCAT(minor_category, ': ', CAST(percentage_share AS STRING)), ', ' ORDER BY percentage_share DESC) as top5_categories_with_shares
FROM category_shares
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
